about: The one pointer to the model of the robot as it is now. Every simulator, rehearsal, video and new training task loads this variant unless it states a historical model on purpose. Change it in the same commit that adds a newer dated variant, and update the robotics checkout's CURRENT-STATE.json fact battery_sim_model_20261104 (the key keeps its first name; its value is always the current model) to the same manifest hash.
describes: battery backpack with the Crazepony 2S 3000 mAh battery (frame and cap rev M5, print V1.47, screwed to the OpenRB box), old switch, DFR1202 and plug leads reused; A7Z on the orange V1.35 roof saddle without lid; U20CAM head with microphones and touch board. Total mass matched to the robot weighed at 918 g on 2026-11-23; 64.7 g of the correction is sourced, 52.05 g is spread over parts still estimated (extensions/battery-walk-20261122/mass-audit-20261123/summary.txt in the robotics checkout).

historical.battery-v2m5-20261121: 2026-11-22 to 11-23: same robot, masses estimated at 1034.76 g, 116.8 g above the weighed robot
historical.battery-20261104: 2026-11-04 to 11-22: V1.40/V1.41 battery backpack with the Tattu 2S 650 mAh on the cap
historical.asbuilt: 2026-10-15 bench box, Pi Zero W head
historical.plugged: charger pack on the bench supply (A7Z saddle drawn white, rear converter box); retired 2026-11-03
historical.battery: 2026-10-15 battery backpack plan, superseded by battery-20261104
